title_en: MagicCon Atlanta Preview Panel Liveblog - IGN
body_en:
Wizards of the Coast is hosting a preview panel at MagicCon Atlanta, showing off all the sets coming to Magic in 2027. While we know of most of the in-universe sets coming to the game next year, the real mystery is the two yet-to-be revealed Universes Beyond crossover sets.
We're watching the stream live, and we'll keep this article updated with all the latest announcements.
Wizards of the Coast is covering Nauctis, The Sunken Realm, and has just showed off the first card, and it's a Seal Monk, brilliant.
Jackie Thomas is the Senior Tech Editor at IGN and the PC components queen. She's been covering gaming hardware for more than a decade for IGN, TechRadar, Gizmodo, PC Gamer and more. You can follow her  @Jackiecobra
